name: Mibu Soutarou
source:
"I... Like it here. Looking at the sea at night makes my mind go blank."

Star Sign: Scorpio
The kind and gentle school doctor. Shinnosuke's older brother.

He always seems to be sleeping at the nurse's office.
A faint existence that seems like he could just float away, a vague kind of guy.
But he gets excited when he looks at strange things.
His family specializes in tea ceremony.
